entries.scope: A native form of fieldsets shown one at a time, with single choice, multiple choice and text answers, choice descriptions, required and data-required questions, Skip for optional ones, authored or generated errors, a progress row, Enter to advance, disabled questions for branching and normal form submission.
entries.adaptation: Each question is a native fieldset named by its legend; the browser's constraint validation checks answers, hidden questions use hidden, and without JavaScript the form shows every question and still submits.

upstream.note: Requirements and boundaries: design reference web-extensions-review. The inventory page renders client-side, so this review relies on the 2026-09-13 inventory review. Full visual parity and spoken output unverified.
upstream.requirements: Name each question with a legend, show one error per question next to it and move focus to the control to fix, keep hidden questions out of the tab order, let optional questions be skipped and keep the form usable without JavaScript.

limitations: Showing one question, required radios, data-required checkboxes that ignore disabled ones, generated and authored errors, aria-invalid and aria-describedby, Enter, Skip clearing an answer, Back focus, a disabled question left out, submit and requestSubmit() opening the first unanswered question, answer shortcuts, the review step, saved progress, FormData and destroy are checked in a browser; screen reader output, forced colors and enlarged text remain unverified. There are no answer keyboard shortcuts, no summary step and no saved progress; the page owns persistence and branching.
